economic_hypothesis: A completed 15-minute displacement is only an event detector. Its trading scenario depends on the prior-only liquidity state. Directionally aligned Hawkes arrivals, taker pressure, depth imbalance and open-interest buildup with non-extreme toxicity imply price discovery continuation. Extreme flow toxicity with weak marginal price response, opposing or replenished depth and non-confirming open interest implies order-flow exhaustion and reversal. The boundary between these states is recalibrated from past events only because identical raw values represent different liquidity regimes across weeks.

data_contract.execution_source: separately downloaded official Binance Vision one-minute klines
data_contract.missing_depth_policy: No candidate evaluation before 2023-01-01; a decision with missing depth, VPIN, Hawkes or OI state is NO_TRADE.

event_detector.absolute_log_return_threshold: prior 60-day rolling 65th percentile of absolute 15-minute returns

state_classifier.type: multinomial logistic regression with L2 regularization
state_classifier.retraining_schedule: once at 00:00 UTC using observations and labels whose full 60-minute horizon ended before that UTC day
state_classifier.standardization: median and interquartile range from the trailing training window only

historical_label.note: These labels are permitted only for fully historical training rows and are unavailable to test/live decisions.

PRICE_DISCOVERY_CONTINUATION.entry: next one-minute open after the completed event bar
PRICE_DISCOVERY_CONTINUATION.stop: opposite extreme of the completed 15-minute event window plus 0.10 prior one-minute ATR

TOXIC_FLOW_EXHAUSTION.entry: next one-minute open after the completed event bar
TOXIC_FLOW_EXHAUSTION.stop: event-direction extreme of the completed 15-minute event window plus 0.10 prior one-minute ATR

scenario_execution.stop_gap_policy: worse of stop or one-minute open

quantity_rule: current NAV times 0.03 divided by per-unit expected stop loss including price distance, entry and stop costs, market impact and funding allowance
